diagnostics.message: The Karpenter Provisioner names the AWSNodeTemplate `default` in `providerRef`, but its `yaml_body` has no reference to the node-template resource. Terraform can therefore create the Provisioner before the referenced template exists; make the Provisioner depend on the node-template resource.

The Provisioner references the AWSNodeTemplate named `default` via `providerRef`, but its manifest does not reference the Terraform resource that creates that template. Without an ordering edge, Terraform may apply the Provisioner before the referenced AWSNodeTemplate exists.

fix.expression:
<<-YAML
apiVersion: karpenter.sh/v1alpha5
kind: Provisioner
metadata:
  name: default
spec:
  requirements:
    - key: "karpenter.k8s.aws/instance-category"
      operator: In
      values: ["c", "m"]
    - key: "karpenter.k8s.aws/instance-cpu"
      operator: In
      values: ["8", "16", "32"]
    - key: "karpenter.k8s.aws/instance-hypervisor"
      operator: In
      values: ["nitro"]
    - key: "topology.kubernetes.io/zone"
      operator: In
      values: ${jsonencode(local.azs)}
    - key: "kubernetes.io/arch"
      operator: In
      values: ["arm64", "amd64"]
    - key: "karpenter.sh/capacity-type"
      operator: In
      values: ["spot", "on-demand"]
  kubeletConfiguration:
    containerRuntime: containerd
    maxPods: 110
  limits:
    resources:
      cpu: 1000
  consolidation:
    enabled: true
  providerRef:
    name: ${kubectl_manifest.karpenter_node_template.name}
  ttlSecondsUntilExpired: 604800
YAML
